page.overview:
Who is Morrighan Ferus?

is a lagomore paladin and Champion of the Matron of Ravens, formerly a bartender and rogue. She is played by Erica Lindbeck.

thumb|270px| Morrighan is "a really cute bunny girl" standing about 5'10", with bright green eyes and grey bunny ears. When first seen working the bar at The Maiden's Wish casino she was wearing a feathered showgirl outfit, but later wore traditional rogue attire.

During her time in Kymal Mor had a slightly rehearsed demeanor, constantly acting surprised, although appearing more genuine when she gained trust with people. After joining the Crown Keepers and becoming the champion of the Matron of Ravens, she felt somewhat more comfortable around her friends, although when it came to her purpose she blindly trusted the goddess; if the situation she faced did not have a clear solution, she would turn to the Raven Queen to tell her what to do.

Morrighan was born in the Feywild and entered the Material Plane with help from an old woman named Morrigan, to live and grow up in Kymal for the past twenty-six years. She had been a bartender (among other things) for about three years but had only been working at The Maiden's Wish for a few weeks when encountered by the Crown Keepers. Her modus operandi was to work at a casino, siphon off what cash she could, and then after a while move to the next one before they were even aware of what had happened.
